items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He, Buck Clayton, and Harry Edison. Those are the two I was thinking of together with Count when he first came to New York.

ctx.x: He, Buck Clayton, and Harry Edison. Those are the two I was thinking of together with Count when he first came to New York.
Yeah. Now, I'm glad cause I've been worrying myself about that name. I knew it.

items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I used to go listen to Erskine Hawkins

ctx.x: Yes, he is. So I think after he heard what -- well, after I went to New York, I became so engrossed in listening to the solos, going from place to place. I used to go listen to Erskine Hawkins, go listen to Charlie Shavers, go listen to Roy Eldridge.
What did you think of Erskine Hawkins?
